purpose: Converge existing Ordivon verification islands through a thin task-local obligation/binding waist while preserving natural verifier ownership and keeping execution, evidence, formal proof, and domain acceptance distinct.
invariants: verifier execution != gate discharge unless the natural verifier emits admissible evidence
no universal verifier, verifier registry/ranker, proof language, or global evidence truth store

nodes.label: VerificationObligationCarrier
nodes.responsibility: Project each existing Cognitive Circuit Composition Gate into an exact digest-bound task-local obligation without inventing new domain semantics.

nodes.label: VerificationObligationCompiler
nodes.responsibility: Compile already-authored Gate requirements deterministically into V01 obligations while preserving exact Circuit/gate/support-scope identity.

nodes.label: TaskLocalVerifierBinding
nodes.responsibility: Validate exact caller-authored verifier bindings against obligations; no discovery, ranking, installation, liveness probing, or execution.
evidence: Research<->Artifact and Web<->Security R3 dogfood PASS

nodes.label: NaturalVerifierProviders
nodes.responsibility: Use owner-native/formal/empirical/reality verifiers through exact task-local bindings instead of introducing a universal verifier runtime.

nodes.label: EvidenceClaimThinModel
nodes.owner: services/runtime R13 plus natural evidence owners
nodes.responsibility: Represent physical machine claims as subject+claim+scope+witness+observation+boundary+limitation without replacing owner-native evidence schemas.

nodes.label: EvidenceCurrentnessAndInvalidation
nodes.owner: owner-specific currentness plus task-local compatibility layer
nodes.responsibility: Keep compatibility, currentness, and admissibility distinct and invalidate retained support when exact owner/currentness conditions no longer hold.
nodes.nextTrigger: Add broader dependency-aware incremental invalidation only when repeated revalidation cost or stale-support defects justify it.

nodes.label: ModelImplementationRefinement
nodes.responsibility: Trace or prove that production implementation preserves the properties expressed by its formal abstraction; model checking alone is not implementation proof.
nodes.nextAction: Choose one high-value Runtime invariant and build an explicit implementation-to-model trace/refinement gate before claiming stronger formal coverage.

nodes.label: CompletionSemantics
nodes.responsibility: Keep physical execution terminality, evidence availability, obligation discharge, mechanical closure, and domain acceptance as separate standings.
evidence: Security executor receipt != authoritative consequence observation

sequencing.exit: Task-local obligation/binding thin waist implemented and real R3 owner-native seams dogfooded.
Pacti exact-version formal provider passed accepted/refinement/quotient/negative-control dogfood without project dependency admission.
Physical ExecutionCircuit can carry evidence obligations without duplicating Composition/domain truth.
Each new mechanism must have a repeated real consumer and a natural external owner.
Effect exists + evidence admissible + required obligations discharged + owner/domain acceptance, with no standing collapse.

immediateNextActions: Continue Runtime RW1 with R04 ReservationContract; do not divert Runtime into verification orchestration.
After Runtime RW1 closes, implement R07 AuthorityContract and R08 OperationCircuitCompiler using existing EvidenceObligations design.
Only then connect physical execution evidence to V05/R13; preserve owner-native evidence schemas.
Add one explicit Runtime model-to-implementation trace gate for a high-value invariant.
Do not install/admit Lean until a real theorem-proof workload cannot be adequately served by cheaper natural verifiers.
Do not promote Pacti beyond shadow until a second independent production-relevant formal-contract seam creates recurring demand.
